cues: A storage class decides where a variable lives, its starting value, where it can be seen, and how long it lasts.
Auto is the default for local variables.
Extern variables are global, visible everywhere.
Register asks for a fast CPU register.
And beware: an automatic variable you forget to initialise contains rubbish, not zero.
text: A storage class decides where a variable lives, its starting value, where it can be seen, and how long it lasts. Auto is the default for local variables. Extern variables are global, visible everywhere. Static ones keep their value. Register asks for a fast CPU register. And beware: an automatic variable you forget to initialise contains rubbish, not zero.
